continuity.opening: Pinocchio is carrying Geppetto through the open sea, but his strength is failing before they reach shore.
continuity.closing: After months of work, study, and generous choices, Pinocchio becomes a real boy and shares a renewed home with Geppetto.
continuity.next: The complete story closes with a family transformed by sustained choices rather than shortcuts.

learningObjective: Explain how repeated choices reveal character using evidence, contrast, habit language, and a complete reflective conclusion.

beats.title: The Tunny's Rescue
beats.purpose: Bring father and son safely from open water to the beginning of an ordinary life.

beats.title: False Friends Again
beats.purpose: Prove Pinocchio's changed judgment when the Fox and Cat try their old language again.

beats.title: An Honest Apology
beats.purpose: Show accountability through a direct apology to the Talking Cricket and care for Geppetto.

beats.title: One Hundred Buckets
beats.purpose: Turn difficult daily labour into a concrete expression of love.

beats.title: Lamp-Wick's Last Lesson
beats.purpose: Let Pinocchio face the human cost of Toyland and carry the lesson forward.

beats.title: Work by Day, Study by Night
beats.purpose: Build transformation through patient habits rather than a single dramatic promise.

beats.title: The Fifty Pennies
beats.purpose: Test Pinocchio's priorities when the Fairy needs the reward he saved for himself.

beats.title: A Real Boy
beats.purpose: Make the magical transformation the visible result of a change already completed through action.
